text:
maya: quick question — i have a small semver patch (pkg version bump + changelog line) that needs to land before cutoff at 18:00 PT. it's docs + package.json only. should i ask for a late-merge exception or wait for next cycle?

sam: ping @maya — what's the PR? can you confirm no migration/db/runtime changes? :eyes:

maya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/6842 — it's just `package.json` version and `CHANGELOG.md` entry. CI is green. no migrations.

ryan: oncall here — if it's docs+pkg only and CI is green, i'm +1 for a soft exception. we still need an owner for immediate rollback/monitoring though.

leila: i can own monitoring for the first hour post-merge. @sam will you approve cherry-pick policy for release branch?

sam: approve in principle. please document the exception in the release-exceptions doc with a brief risk assessment. if it's <1 file change, tag `release:docs` and i'll rubber-stamp.

deploy-bot: scheduled freeze at 2026-04-01T18:00:00-07:00 — exceptions must be approved before 17:30 PT.

maya: ok filing now. i'll include a rollback plan `revert-pr-6842` and steps. planned cherry-pick: 
```
git checkout release/v1.5
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
git push origin release/v1.5
```

sam: sgtm. @ryan please be ready to rollback if anything flares. i'll sign off once the exception doc link is posted.

maya: exception filed: https://docs.internal/release-exceptions/6842 — short note + risk = low. requesting manual approval.

ryan: i'm good to monitor. one request — hold merge until after 17:45 PT so SRE can run a quick post-merge smoke.

sam: approved. merge window: 17:45–17:55 PT. @maya please merge and ping #eng-oncall when done. :thumbsup:

maya: merging at 17:46 PT now. will ping once live.

deploy-bot: merge recorded: PR 6842 merged into release/v1.5 by maya at 17:46:22 PT.

maya: deployed to staging; doing quick smoke now.

leila: smoke looks good from docs perspective. no broken links or formatting regressions.

ryan: saw a ~30s 502 spike during the deploy, autoscaler rolled traffic, but all recovered. continuing to monitor for 30m.

maya: thanks everyone — closing exception and adding note to changelog ownership for next cycle.
